messages:
jordan: Hey team — first day! trying to switch kube contexts but `kubectl config get-contexts` shows nothing. I set KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/redwood:/Users/jordan/.kube/config and now getting 'current-context: ""'. Any pointers?

maya: Welcome! quick Q: which cluster are you trying to reach (hosted vs staging/dedicated)?

jordan: Trying to reach the staging cluster — expected context name 'staging-us-west1'. I can curl the API host but kubectl doesn't list contexts.

sam: Probable issue: when KUBECONFIG has multiple files, kubectl merges them but if one is malformed it can hide contexts. Try: 
```
kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/redwood config view --raw
```
Or just `kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/redwood config view` to inspect.

jordan: Ran `kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/redwood config view` — I see clusters and users but no `contexts` section. Looks like creds/context weren't added by the onboarding agent.

maya: Ok that explains it. I'll create a context and a rolebinding for you. @sam can you do a temporary RoleBinding for user 'jordan@redwood' with `view` on `staging` namespace until IAM sync finishes?

sam: On it. pinging infra-bot to open an RBAC ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket created: RBAC-3829. Assigned to sam. ETA: ~45m. Summary: Add RoleBinding (namespace=staging) for user=jordan@redwood role=view.

sam: Done. I added a RoleBinding `onboard-jordan-staging` in namespace `staging`. You should be able to run:
```
kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/redwood --context=staging-us-west1 get pods -n staging
```
If the context still doesn't exist locally, try:
```
kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/redwood config set-context staging-us-west1 --cluster=staging-cluster --user=jordan@redwood
kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/redwood config use-context staging-us-west1
```

jordan: Tried `kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/redwood config use-context staging-us-west1` and now `kubectl get pods -n staging` works! thanks 🙏

maya: :tada: Welcome aboard! Heads up — we'll add you to #platform-oncall after you finish the onboarding checklist. If you need access to Dedicated later, ping eng-infra and CC me.

jordan: Sweet. One last q: can I get namespace `dev` too? I saw some example apps there.

sam: Granted you `view` in `dev` as well. `kubectl get ns` should show `dev` and `staging`. If you need `edit` for a short task, file a request with reason + duration.

jordan: Confirmed: namespaces show `dev` and `staging`. Able to list pods in `dev` as well. Thanks everyone!

maya: Closing the loop — updated the onboarding doc to include a quick `kubectl config view` sanity check and a short troubleshooting checklist. :white_check_mark:
